source.name: A dialog created with keyboard: false must stay open however often Escape is pressed
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43070) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Escape must not dismiss a dialog opened with keyboard: false
journey.goal: The confirmation dialog stays open however often Escape is pressed, so the user can still enter the code and send the transfer

functionalJourney.title: Confirm with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking the backdrop does not close the dialog; entering the code and clicking Send completes the transfer

guards.title: Cancel transfer still closes the dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Tabbing to Cancel transfer and pressing Enter closes the dialog and records the cancellation

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handling depended exclusively on the native cancel event, which in certain circumstances (e.g., after repeated activations) failed to preventDefault, allowing the dialog to close despite keyboard: false.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a keydown listener for Escape on the dialog element that preventsDefault and replicates the cancel‑listener logic for both modal and non‑modal dialogs, ensuring Escape never dismisses the dialog when keyboard: false.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will no longer close the dialog when opened with keyboard: false, allowing users to dismiss only via explicit actions (Cancel or Send) and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility.
functional_risks: Duplicate handling of Escape if both cancel and keydown listeners execute, but hide() is idempotent.
Extra backdrop transitions may occur when keyboard: false, but they are harmless.
Ensure no interference with other components that rely on Escape keydown.
verification_requirements: Press Escape any number of times while the dialog is open with keyboard: false; the dialog must remain open and focus must stay inside the dialog.
Press Escape while the dialog is open with keyboard: true; the dialog must close.
Verify that activating the Cancel or Send buttons still works as expected.
Confirm that focus trapping and modal behavior are unaffected.
